# Add delivery address designs (fixture, text description of 4 frames)

No PRD exists for this feature.

1. "Address list": list of saved addresses with radio buttons, link "+ Add new address", button "Deliver here".
2. "Add address - map": map with pin, button "Confirm location", search field "Search area".
3. "Add address - details": fields House/Flat, Street, Landmark (optional), Label chips Home/Work/Other, button "Save address".
4. "Address list - updated": the new address appears selected at the top, button "Deliver here".
